searchText: `test_bal_block_rewards` fails in reth with: `Error: block base fee mismatch: got 2, expected 7` Does it pass in any client? Yes this was brought up here as well: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1422280358258540584/1423307517932343316 We will make an appropriate fix here. Fix incoming [here](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/2262/files) --- edit: merged now, not yet released! Also what branch of reth is the bals branch? 👀 EIP-7702 question... EIP-7928 states "Authority addresses that set delegations **MUST** be included with their code changes." If anything is set wrong during the auth validation, we never get to updating the code or incrementing the nonce... is the address then present in the BAL with no account changes (since we mark the address warm to start the auth validation process)?
